description: Erection of a hip to gable and rear roof extension with three additional roof windows to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (S3200 (Rev A)  Received:  12 March 2020
S2302 (Rev C); S3201 (Rev C)  Received:  13 March 2020
Draft Location Plan  Received:  21 January 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The front porch extension hereby approved shall be constructed only with matching painted rendered walls, matching concrete roof tiles, one white UPVC front door, two white UPVC full height front windows and one white UPVC side window, and shall be retained permanently as such.  
The rear roof dormer extension hereby approved shall be formed from side cheeks, and front elevation clad in matching concrete roof tiles only and two white UPVC rear window units, and shall be retained permanently as such.
Condition : 4 - Prior to completing construction of the front porch extension hereby approved the existing car port structure shall be permanently removed.
Condition : 5 - No additional doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the front porch extension and rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
